$comment: Outage / error pages rendered as a shell console. One entry per page; the 5W fields mirror the log format in docs/aidlc/54 §6. Served from /errors/<slug>/ (404 also as /404.html).

terminal.footer: Mohammad Saniyat Hossain · Staff Software Engineer

retry.exhausted: gave up after {attempts} attempts — run retry to try again

not-found.title: Page not found
not-found.message: That address does not exist on this site.
not-found.reason: no route or asset matches this URL
not-found.hint: Check the spelling, or head back to the home page.

server-error.title: Something broke on my side
server-error.message: The server hit an unexpected error while handling your request.
server-error.reason: unhandled exception in the request pipeline
server-error.hint: This is not your fault. Try again in a minute.

bad-gateway.title: Upstream is not answering
bad-gateway.message: The site's asset store returned an error instead of the page.
bad-gateway.reason: static asset binding responded with a 5xx status
bad-gateway.hint: It is usually brief. Reload in a moment.

maintenance.title: We'll be right back
maintenance.message: The site is down briefly for scheduled maintenance and a few improvements. Please check back shortly — or reach me by email in the meantime.
maintenance.hint: No data is lost. Nothing to do but wait.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.message: This page isn't saved on your device yet and the network is unreachable.
offline.reason: navigator reports no connection and nothing is cached
offline.hint: Reconnect, then retry. Pages you have visited keep working offline.
